theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid n)) (u : Euclid n → ℝ) (σ : Measure (Euclid P)) (q : Euclid P → Euclid n) (h : Euclid P → ℝ) (A : Set (Euclid P)), IsOpen U → Continuous q → IntegrableOn u U → σ univ < ∞ → Integrable h σ → σ Aᶜ = 0 → (∀ b : Euclid n → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) b → HasCompactSupport b → tsupport b ⊆ U → ∫ y in U, b y * u y = ∫ x, b (q x) * h x ∂σ) → ∀ B : Set (Euclid n), MeasurableSet B → B ⊆ U → volume (B ∩ {y | u y ≠ 0}) ≤ volume (B ∩ q '' A)
